description: A Kivy-based GUI application demonstrating the use of RecycleView's key_viewclass attribute to display heterogeneous widgets (TextInput, CheckBox, Spinner) with data-driven and random data. It manages widget states externally to handle recycling efficiently.

classes.name: NumberedLabel
classes.description: A RelativeLayout displaying an index and title label.

classes.name: RVTextInputLine
classes.description: A BoxLayout containing a label and a TextInput, representing a text input widget.

classes.name: RVCheckBoxLine
classes.description: A BoxLayout containing a label and a CheckBox, representing a checkbox widget.

classes.name: RVSpinnerLine
classes.description: A BoxLayout containing a label and a Spinner, representing a dropdown selection widget.

classes.name: Application
classes.description: Main app class demonstrating RecycleView's key_viewclass for heterogeneous widget display and state management.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Initializes data with 200 randomly assigned widget types and loads the UI.

methods.name: initialize_active_values
methods.description: Sets up initial active values for each widget based on its type.

methods.name: get_active_value
methods.description: Retrieves the active value for a widget at a given index, or default if not set.

methods.name: handle_update
methods.description: Updates the active value for a widget at a specific index.

methods.name: create_random_input
methods.description: Randomly selects and creates a data dictionary for a widget type.

methods.name: create_spinner
methods.description: Creates data dictionary for a spinner widget.

methods.name: create_checkbox
methods.description: Creates data dictionary for a checkbox widget.

methods.name: create_textinput
methods.description: Creates data dictionary for a text input widget.
